properties.title: 1942 City Map Landmarks
properties.description: The landmarks numbered in the key of the 1942 'Map of Hyderabad City', placed at their present positions. name_1942 is the name as printed in the key; identified_as is today's name where it differs, and basis says how the two were matched. position_source says where the point comes from (the heritage buildings list or OpenStreetMap). 21 of the 28 keys are placed; Afzal Gate, the Municipal Rest House (Suleh Sarai), the Town Hall, Jagirdar College and the Government Central Press have no sourced position yet, the Industrial Area is an area, and the Qutubshahi Tombs are printed twice in the key.
properties.huo:source_name: Map of Hyderabad City (Municipal Publicity Department, 5-3-1942); positions from the GHMC heritage list and OpenStreetMap
